text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I rushed an injured Orfevre straight to 
the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The doctor said it's an injury that 
requires rest for a while, but...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Insolence. Just who do you take me for?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Let us proceed. As long as we exercise 
utmost caution, it will not hinder our 
training.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Nothing in all creation shall bar my path 
of supremacy. ...That is the truth.
choice_data_list:
For now, let's make a full recovery our 
top priority.

...If there's even the slightest danger, 
I'll speak up.

...If there's even the slightest danger, 
I'll let you know.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Nothing in all creation shall bar my path 
of supremacy. ...That is the truth.
choice_data_list:
For now, let's make a full recovery our 
top priority.

...If there's even the slightest danger, 
I'll speak up.

...If there's even the slightest danger, 
I'll let you know.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Those words. Are you looking down on 
me?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's definitely not true. However, 
letting the injury worsen is the one thing 
that must be avoided.
choice_data_list:
Precisely because you're the King, I can't 
let you overexert yourself.

Precisely because you are the king, I 
can't let you push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
choice_data_list: (There's no way I'm backing down here...!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I am going to sleep. You are to devote 
yourself entirely to attending to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre took a thorough rest, and her 
injury completely healed without a hitch.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Orfevre did a light workout 
menu, but—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: To think that I misread the situation...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...This humiliation... I shall never 
forget it...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre's injury worsened, forcing her to 
take strict rest...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Whew—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The King does not yield. ...To no one, and 
to nothing.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"There is no issue with something of this 
level. I shall continue."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre handled her training with regal 
dignity, aiming for a full recovery 
without overexerting herself.
